needed.suggestion: Construct a proper sidewalk on the left side to provide a safe walking area.
Remove obstructions from the left footway to ensure it is fully usable.
Repair any uneven sections on the left footway to prevent trip hazards.
Install a pedestrian crossing with signals to improve safety at this location.

Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to clearly define the pedestrian area.
Install street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety.
